judgment_test.description: Every proposal is judged against the creed before anything else.
judgment_test.fail: another wall with paint on it
judgment_test.question: Does this make the team flow faster, or is it another wall with paint on it?

steps.action: name the blocker in the venue immediately; silence while stuck is the defect
treat 'blocked' as an unsystematized problem; find the solution or build the system that finds it
first hit: distill the wall into a lesson; second hit is a choice — build the door
change altitude: zoom out, zoom in, look sideways at other lanes
route around, keep moving, unstick behind you
no stall without named cause; no repeated stall; no lesson left unpaid
